interpretive_choices.R_freeze: proxy = galaxy's own last measured radius (r_max), NOT derived from a real gas-pressure profile (not in the data)
interpretive_choices.u_definition: u = rho_HDF_local/rho_HDF_max (NOT rho_excess/rho_gal as in Domain T/V) -- removes rho_gal as a free param
interpretive_choices.outer_bc_used: value condition u(R_freeze)=cs0^2/(2*pi*G*rho_HDF_max*R_freeze^2) only; the given derivative condition is a redundant consistency check on the same SIS profile, not a third independent equation
